name: Can I combine two small bathrooms into one larger bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Can I combine two small bathrooms into one larger bathroom in a home remodel?
mainEntity.text: Can I combine two small bathrooms into one larger bathroom in a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Combining two small bathrooms can create a much better primary suite or a more comfortable shared bath, but the design and construction challenges are real. The project usually involves removing walls, rerouting plumbing, adjusting electrical and ventilation, and rebuilding the new room from scratch. It can also affect the home’s bathroom count, which may matter for resale and daily use. Before deciding, homeowners should ask whether the new larger bathroom truly improves the house or simply trades one problem for another. In some homes, a better solution is to keep both bathrooms but improve one of them significantly. If the combined room will serve as the home’s main bath, it should be planned carefully around storage, privacy, and traffic flow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, two small bathrooms can sometimes be combined into one larger bathroom if the structure, plumbing, and circulation path allow it. The result can be a more luxurious primary bath, but the project is usually more complex than reworking a single room.
